messages:
Zoe K.: quick sync 52 final go/no-go checklist for EdgeCloud catalog listing + SI integrator announcement. locks: hero copy, partner quote, press embargo owner, screenshots + short demo, staging creds, and publish fallback. target publish = Wed Aug 14.

Ravi M.: I can own press embargo and partner comms. partner asked for Tue 23:59 PT embargo if legal clears. Legal deadline = Mon 12:00 PT. fallback = staggered release next day.

Elodie F.: I'll take hero + listing microcopy. draft hero: "Redwood + EdgeCloud: predictable LLM inference where you run it". CTAs: `Try in your cloud`, `Request demo`. will add a dev `Quickstart` link for docs.

Tom S.: staging infra: deploy-bot, please provision a tenant with limited tokens and send creds to me + Elodie. need sample dataset template for SI.

deploy-bot: Staging tenant provisioned: rwd-edgecloud-stg-0814. Creds emailed to Tom S., Elodie F. (expires 72h).

Tom S.: got creds. I'll also attach a teardown job to revoke keys 48h after creation. will run perf numbers and post p50/p95 for the listing.

Zoe K.: screenshots we need: hero banner, 90s demo clip, latency table, and partner badge. partner wants to review screenshot frames before quote.

Elodie F.: screenshot script example:

```
# screenshot run
curl -s -X POST https://staging.redwood.com/v1/generate \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $STG_KEY' \
  -d '{"model":"rw-accelerate","input":"Summarize the EdgeCloud partnership in two sentences"}'
```

Ravi M.: partner quote ask sent. requested 1-2 sentence quote + approval of hero by Thu EOD. dry run scheduled for Mon 16:00 PT. can SI lead make that slot?

Tom S.: Mon 16:00 PT works. I'll run the demo and record raw terminal + screen. will mask keys and store raw clips in restricted S3.

deploy-bot: Calendar invite: EdgeCloud catalog dry run on 2024-08-12T23:00:00Z (Mon 16:00 PT) 52 invite sent.

Elodie F.: legal note: partner legal must approve co-branded assets by Mon 12:00 PT. if they don't, we'll publish Redwood-only listing and follow with joint blog later.

Ravi M.: owners recap -> Embargo & partner comms: Ravi M.; Hero & listing copy: Elodie F.; Staging & perf: Tom S.; Legal & runbook: Zoe K. shout if you need to swap.

Zoe K.: added a short fallback plan to the runbook: conditional CMS flag + a follow-up partner case study in week 2. will post link after dry run.

Tom S.: small infra note: will include measured p50/p95 for rw-accelerate and rw-base-v2 and annotate whether numbers are warm or cold-start.

Elodie F.: uploading hero variants and CTA localization notes (EN/FR/DE) to the drive now. will tag lines needing partner legal review.

Ravi M.: thanks everyone 52 i'll coordinate the embargo email once quote + legal are green. :rocket:
